description_target.target_text: Normalize the motif in each chamber up to rotation and reflection. Three of the candidate rooms belong to the same equivalence class, while one does not. Output a strip marking the odd chamber with cyan(8).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Walls (1/7/9) partition the board into rooms, each stamped with a
 ;; motif. Compare motifs up to rotation/flip and emit a 1-row strip
 ;; (one cell per room, reading order): cyan(8) marks the rooms whose
 ;; motif matches no other room's.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (wall? v) (member? v (list 1 7 9)))
     (define rooms
       (sort (objects (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
                                          (if (wall? (at g r c)) 0 1)))
                      0)
             (lambda (a b) (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                               (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                    (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))
     (define (spin p t)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((= t 0) (list r c))
               ((= t 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= t 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= t 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= t 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= t 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= t 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define (dihedral cells)  ;; the motif's 8 normalized variants
       (if (empty? cells)
           (list (list))
           (remove-duplicates
            (for/list ((t (in-range 8)))
              (let* ((raw (map (lambda (p) (spin p t)) cells))
                     (mr (min-of first raw))
                     (mc (min-of second raw)))
                (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr)
                                             (- (second p) mc)))
                           raw)
                      cell<))))))
     (define sets
       (map (lambda (room)
              (dihedral
               (filter (lambda (x) x)
                       (map (lambda (p)
                              (and (not (zero? (at g (first p)
                                                   (second p))))
                                   (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 room))
                                         (- (second p)
                                            (obj-c1 room)))))
                            (obj-cells room)))))
            rooms))
     (define uniques  ;; room indices whose set intersects only itself
       (map first
            (filter (lambda (pair)
                      (= 1 (count-if
                            (lambda (s)
                              (any? (lambda (v) (member? v s))
                                    (second pair)))
                            sets)))
                    (enumerate-list sets))))
     (grid-from-fn 1 (length rooms)
                   (lambda (r c) (if (member? c uniques) 8 0))))))
